independence_reassessment.finding: Specialists derive several required fields from age or thermal-state primitives, but none removes a complete parent family with the currently bound ARCANA authority and provider chain. Ocean age can predict only the thermal/isostatic bathymetry component; current structural templates do not determine thickness; continental state remains a separate domain family.
independence_reassessment.reduced_or_replaced_representation: Use an oceanic AGE_FIELD instead of carrying both age and ridge chronology. Ridge/formation chronology is an optional causal authoring route, not an additional primitive.

components.thermal_isostatic_depth: Can be generated conditionally from age and a published/validated cooling plus isostatic model; age alone is insufficient because model and material parameters matter.
components.ridge_relief: May be represented by a selected thermal model near an explicit ridge source; no ridge source is authorized by current kinematics.
components.tectonic_dynamic_relief: Not derived by plate-cooling age model; unresolved and not needed as invented detail for the bounded static input contract.
components.trench_relief: Requires explicit trench/subduction geometry and a chosen structural model; not inferred from convergent-demand edges.
components.intraplate_volcanic_relief: Independent local feature support if later required; no current provider/authority.
components.sediment_load: Optional structural modifier only when sediment state is authored and model requires it.

bathymetry_reduction.minimum_representation: A datum-aware, uncertainty-bearing, long-wavelength ocean-floor support over the modeled ocean domain, coherent with the surface/water support. Prefer a small set of basin/domain controls or a low-resolution correlated field; keep local features as explicit sparse features only if later authorized.
constraints: separate marine-floor support from land mask semantics
bathymetry_reduction.provider_gap: No current R6-bound tool consumes the authorized age state and returns a validated total ARCANA ocean-elevation field with nonthermal relief policy. A cooling model is a component materializer only.

minimum_ontology.meaning: Crust formed as oceanic crust; physical family, not surface-ocean mask.

crustal_structure_reduction.excluded_semantics: Current crust_class/province_class design labels do not supply physical thickness, mineralogy, density or rheology. Do not infer land == continental or ocean == oceanic.
crustal_structure_reduction.generation: Author a small domain/template parameter set with ranges and provenance; a support-aware mapper materializes the field for OrbData/SHELLS. OrbData Assign consumes upstream crust thickness and does not derive it from current R6 topology/isostasy. GWB configured feature geometry does not create ARCANA authority for thickness.
constraints: domain boundary continuity or explicitly supported discontinuity
crustal_structure_reduction.range_type: RANGE_CONSTRAINED plus ENSEMBLE_REQUIRED until ARCANA domain families and parameter provenance are selected

oceanic_age_reduction.reason: A T0 age field directly conditions established oceanic cooling models. Requiring full plate history only to derive age adds tectonic chronology/kinematics that ARCANA has not authorized. Plate ID and current kinematics do not encode age.
